content.text: Two wakings at 19 months is really common, and plenty of toddlers this age do it. Tonight, try a short, boring check-in when he wakes. Go in, keep the lights off, say one calm phrase like "night night, I'm here", and pat his back. Then leave before he's asleep, and don't pick him up or feed him. Doing the same thing every time is what teaches him he can settle himself.
